[b]March 4, 2028: The New Government[/b]

Polenne Strømm under her mandate as dictator signed into law on March 4, 2028, D-37 which would dissolve the Grand Assembly and its structures and establish a new unicameral chamber known as the Supreme Peoples Council, to be elected in 4 year terms as opposed to the Grand Assemblys 5 year terms. With one Deputy or member of the SPC to be allocated to 300,000 citizens making up 150 seats in the chamber as opposed to the old 540 seats that were present. 

The move would be seen as an effort to streamline and eliminate gridlock in the legislature, and snap elections for the newly formed chamber would be scheduled for April 5, 2028.
